description: guard hooks. Logic lives in `scripts/guard_hook.py`; see `dev/design.md` for the design.

hooks.description: Deny a search rooted at the filesystem root — `find /`, `grep -r /`, `rg /` and the `fd`/`ag`/`ack`/`locate` equivalents, a `/`-anchored glob, or a Grep/Glob call whose `path` is `/`. Classifies the tool ARGUMENT and never the caller, so it ignores the agent switches and the mute. Silent for every other call, and fails open on a command it cannot parse.

When the user APPROVES a plan, hold it before it is built until it has been through the plan audit, and again whenever it is revised afterwards. Choosing "tell Claude what to change" runs no tool, so this never fires on feedback. Silent while the session has plan audits muted (`guard-plan off`, the default).

Record a source file, an agent instruction file, or a saved reference written this turn (for a comment-corrector, agents-md-auditor or ext-docs-auditor dispatch) — a subagent's writes included — and require a file saved inside the refs dir to be listed in the refs index (AGENTS.md).

Name the file-reading audits over what this turn edited: comment-corrector / agents-md-auditor over the source and agent-instruction files, ext-docs-auditor over anything written under the refs dir. Records nothing about the turn itself and reads none of the response — the turn audit is the user's to start (/guard:audit-turn), and it resolves its target from the transcript. Silent while the session is muted.

Sweep guard state and turn records past the retention window, record this session's transcript path (the one field guard cannot derive), export GUARD_PROJECT_DIR and GUARD_REFS_DIR, and state the refs rule as session context — plus, when any agent is on, the entry points the user invokes.

When /clear ends a session, hand its session switches to the session replacing it. Matched on `clear` only: every other reason ends a session that is not being replaced. Writes nothing when both switches are muted.
